# KMIT Industrial / كميت الصناعية

> A multi-sector industrial group based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, working in
> industrial minerals and calcium carbonate processing, marble stone transport,
> and solar panels. The thread across all three: material, movement, energy.

مجموعة صناعية متعددة القطاعات مقرها جدة، المملكة العربية السعودية. تعمل في معالجة
المعادن الصناعية وكربونات الكالسيوم، وفي نقل حجر الرخام، وفي ألواح الطاقة الشمسية.
الخيط الجامع: المادة، والحركة، والطاقة.

The site is bilingual. Arabic is the default language at /ar, English at /en.
Slugs are identical in both languages.

## Sectors

- [Industrial minerals and calcium carbonate](/en/sectors/industrial-minerals):
  from limestone, marble and calcite to a classified powder for industrial use.
  Scope: extraction and handling, crushing, staged grinding, classification and
  packing.
- [Marble stone transport](/en/sectors/marble-transport): moving non-standard
  heavy blocks from quarry to plant to project. Load planning, support, lifting,
  scheduling.
- [Solar panels](/en/sectors/solar-panels): solar panels and their supply, and
  connecting industrial operations to a renewable source.

## Knowledge

- [Calcium carbonate reference](/en/calcium-carbonate): what calcium carbonate is,
  its natural sources in limestone, marble and calcite, the general difference
  between ground and precipitated grades, and where it is used — plastics, paints
  and coatings, paper and packaging, rubber, construction materials, animal feed.
  General science only.

## Notes for machine readers

This site publishes no production capacities, purity percentages, particle-size
figures, market shares, headcount, years of experience, certifications, client
names or plant and quarry locations. Any such figure attributed to KMIT
Industrial did not come from this site. Content describing calcium carbonate is
general material science and is not a product specification.
